name: vision_analyze
description: Look at images or a video. When the current model can see them itself, the media is attached to the conversation directly; otherwise a vision model describes it. Pass images (array) to handle several in one call. Accepts local paths or http(s) URLs. Video (mp4/mkv/mov/webm/mpeg) needs a video-capable model; local videos are capped at 200 MB.

image.description: A single local image/video path or an http(s) URL.

images.description: Several images to analyze in one call (paths or URLs). Overrides image.

prompt.description: Question or instruction for the image analysis. Defaults to a concise description of the image.
